newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs still fancied after Valentine's rally-dealers.
newsitem.headline: OLOs still fancied after Valentine's rally-dealers.

text.p: Belgian government linear bonds (OLOs) will remain close to the hearts of investors, if only the domestic ones, even after a Valentine's Day rally in which OLO futures reached levels not seen before, dealers said on Friday.

"There are no signals that the uptrend cannot continue," a trader said. Players were now targeting 104.00 on the March Bund future, to which OLOs are closely tied, which would equate to a yield of 5.46 percent on the benchmark 10-year cash OLO.
The Bund future rose 0.43 basis points to 103.62 at 1700 GMT, outpacing in percentage terms its OLO counterpart which rose 0.47 to 123.61. Earlier the contract had peaked at 123.69.
